summary: Iteration 4 verifies speed/cache fixes for /api/data/cari-extre (date-agnostic fallback), /api/data/fis-detail (bildirim_feed fallback + 25s wait_for cap), and regression on /stock-extre + /stock-detail. BACKEND (pytest 8/9 pass, 33s wall): cari-extre cache_only for known cari 443847 → 200 in 0.98s ✓; unknown cari 99999999 cache_only → 200 in 0.77s empty (no hang) ✓; fis-detail cache_only for known fis 27560618 → 200 in 0.79s with details[2]+totals[1] (feed HIT confirmed from server log) ✓; fis-detail cache_only unknown fis_id=1 → 200 fast empty ✓; stock-extre cache_only stok 683703 → 200 fast valid list ✓; stock-detail cache_only → 200 fast ✓; 400 validations ✓. ONE FAILURE (RCA’d, HIGH priority): /api/data/fis-detail without cache_only for fis_id=1 → returns HTTP 500 with body '{"detail":""}' after ~27s wall (the 25s asyncio.wait_for cap IS enforced, but the raised TimeoutError falls through the generic `except Exception` at data.py:2508 → HTTPException(500, str(e))). Frontend background SWR path will treat this as an error instead of empty. Should return 200 {ok:true, details:[], totals:[], from_cache:false, _timed_out:true}. FRONTEND (Playwright 390x844): logged in as cakmak_ebubekir@hotmail.com/admin (berk user — has_no_tenants:true). Dashboard renders (Nakit/KK/Açık Hesap/Toplam cards at ₺0), all 5 bottom tabs (Dashboard, Stok, Cariler, Raporlar, Ayarlar) switch without crash; empty-state 'Veri kaynağı seçilmedi' shown correctly on tabs requiring tenant (expected because logged-in user has no tenants — the credentials with tenant_id, cakmak.ebubekir29@gmail.com, was explicitly EXCLUDED by main agent). Notification tap injection regression: @notification_pending_tap_v2 type=high_sale, fis_id=27560618, amount=339, tenant=b9f4d960e43f462d9b77915577add71a, belgeno=TESTX, receivedAt=Date.now() → reload /dashboard opens green 'Yüksek Satış' modal in <500ms showing #TESTX + ₺339,00 hero + KALEM 0/İNDİRİM ₺0.00/KDV ₺0.00 + 'Detay satırı bulunamadı' (ÜRÜNLER 0) — modal did not hang or crash. Zero JS errors captured. LIMITATION: The four tenant-scoped end-to-end frontend flows (a-cari-detail spinner, b-stock-miktar+ekstre spinner, c-fis-detail-from-movement, d-tab smoke — item d passed) could not be fully exercised end-to-end because berk has no tenants; a tenanted account is required to see actual list rows. Deprecated packages detected: NONE (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch imports). RN warnings noted: 'shadow*' style props deprecation + expo-notifications web listener limitation (pre-existing from iterations 1-3, not new).

critical.issue: Without cache_only flag, when POS is offline the 25s asyncio.wait_for cap fires (working as designed), BUT the resulting asyncio.TimeoutError is caught by the generic `except Exception as e: raise HTTPException(500, str(e))` at data.py:2505-2509 → returns HTTP 500 with body '{"detail":""}' (empty because TimeoutError has no message). Wall time observed 27.2s for fis_id=1 → status 500 empty. Frontend background SWR request will thus surface an error instead of gracefully falling back to empty. FIX: catch asyncio.TimeoutError explicitly and return 200 with ok:true + empty details/totals (optionally _timed_out:true). Reference: /app/backend/routes/data.py:2486-2509.

rca_of_issue: BUG: /api/data/fis-detail without cache_only returns HTTP 500 with empty detail body when POS is offline. REPRODUCTION: `curl -X POST $BASE/api/data/fis-detail -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOK' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tenant_id":"b9f4d960e43f462d9b77915577add71a","fis_id":1}'` → after 27s: HTTP 500 body `{"detail":""}`. ROOT CAUSE: data.py:2486 wraps _on_demand_request in asyncio.wait_for(timeout=25); when the POS relay is offline the inner call blocks past 25s and asyncio raises TimeoutError (which has no .args/.message → str(e)==''). The generic `except Exception as e: raise HTTPException(500, str(e))` at line 2507-2509 converts it to a 500 with empty detail. This is the ONLY reachable path since the try block wraps everything from line 2483 to 2504. MITIGATION: insert `except asyncio.TimeoutError: return {'ok': True, 'from_cache': False, 'details': [], 'totals': [], '_timed_out': True}` BEFORE the generic Exception handler (i.e. between line 2505 and 2507). Frontend openFisDetail SWR callbacks (customers.tsx/stock.tsx) already handle the null/empty-fresh case, so 200 empty will surface the correct 'Fiş detayı bulunamadı' UI state per spec (`must NOT be stuck forever`, `500s not acceptable`).
